bio.text: Donavan McKinney is the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 13th Congressional District in 2026, after advancing from the August 4 primary.
McKinney is a member of the Michigan House of Representatives, representing District 11, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
McKinney was born in Detroit and earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from the University of Michigan in 2014.
Career roles have included political director of SEIU Healthcare Michigan, legislative director in the Michigan House, and national political director of Climate Power.
